definition.text: (whom Jehovah defends) = Jehoiarib. (1.) The founder of one of the courses of the priests (Neh. 11:10). (2.) Neh. 11:5; a descendant of Judah. (3.) Neh. 12:6. (4.) Ezra 8:16, a “man of understanding” whom Ezra sent to “bring ministers for the house of God.”

lemmas.gloss: Jojarib, the name of four Israelites
Jedajah, the name of two Israelites
Shemajah, the name of twenty-five Israelites
Zecarjah, the name of twenty-nine Israelites
